name: MonarchIcon
title: Icon
summary: An SF Symbol at a Monarch size (16, 20 or 24 points), decorative or labelled.
whenToUse: For icons beside text or inside Monarch components.
whenNotToUse: For tab bar and toolbar items, pass the symbol to Label and let the system size it.
api: init(systemName: String, label: String, size: MonarchIconSize = .md)

options.name: label
options.description: What VoiceOver reads. Without it the icon is decorative.

options.name: size
options.description: sm (16), md (20) or lg (24) points before Dynamic Type.

appearance: Takes the foreground style of its container, so it follows the theme through the text colour around it.
platformNotes: iOS uses SF Symbols, Android uses Material Symbols and the web uses its own icon set, so symbol names are not shared between platforms.
accessibility: Without a label the icon is decorative and hidden from VoiceOver.
With a label the icon is read as that label.
The symbol scales with Dynamic Type.
edgeCases: An unknown symbol name draws nothing; SwiftUI logs a warning.
Symbols mirror in right-to-left layouts only when the symbol itself is directional (for example chevron.forward).

examples.title: Decorative and labelled
